findings.finding: Unknown-length streamed HEAD advertised Content-Length:0 despite nonempty GET
findings.resolution: lean-net dcce82480a6985b3269a474b12b81863e6bdb115 omits unknown length metadata, preserves known11/bodyless statuses and closes producer once; all15stream + encoder/connection + focused headers passed. Final immutable TLS matrix43897188644 is green on Ubuntu/macOS/Windows.

findings.finding: Global flag/config and file shutdown scope needed precise limits
findings.resolution: Flags apply across one process-shared Store, with crossnode propagation explicit. A blocked OS file write/flush cannot be hard-preempted; normal cooperative native SIGTERM bounds are tested, not universal hard realtime exit under a stalled kernel.
